data.one_liner: Material design month picker dialog for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a dialog that lets users pick a month within a date range. It supports locale customization and a builder for custom content. The API is simple and returns the selected DateTime.
use_when: You need a month picker in a Material app
You need a quick, drop‑in dialog without extra dependencies
avoid_when: You need a fully custom UI beyond month selection
You are building a non‑Material design app
You require year‑only or day‑level selection
strengths: Simple API, no build_runner or codegen
No heavy dependencies, only flutter and intl
data.setup_notes: Add mat_month_picker_dialog: ^1.1.3 to pubspec and run flutter pub get

alternatives.name: calendar_date_picker2
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers a more feature‑rich date picker with month selection and additional customization options
